_about: Brightline Bookkeeping: a SYNTHETIC 12-person bookkeeping and accounting firm (invented for testing; not a real company). Cautious owner (risk tolerance 0.2) with a small effort budget. Planted traps: the highest-value idea is too risky for this owner, one idea names a process that does not exist, and two ideas cite a passage that does not support them.

company_input.name: Brightline Bookkeeping
company_input.description: 12-person bookkeeping and accounting firm serving local small businesses. Monthly closes, payroll, and tax-season preparation. Client documents arrive by email, text photo and paper.

processes.name: Client onboarding
processes.description: New clients fill in a paper form; staff re-key it into the practice system and the billing system.

processes.name: Document collection
processes.description: Staff email and call clients each month for bank statements, receipts and payroll changes.

processes.name: Monthly close
processes.description: Bookkeepers categorize transactions, reconcile accounts and send a summary to the client.

processes.name: Tax preparation
processes.description: Seasonal returns prepared by two senior accountants and reviewed by the owner.

processes.name: Billing and collections
processes.description: Monthly invoices; overdue accounts are followed up by the office manager when time allows.

practices.practice: Use structured intake forms with an agent that summarizes and routes new clients
practices.why_it_matters: Cuts repeated questions and double entry

practices.practice: Give staff a retrieval assistant over the firm's own documents, with citations
Start with high-volume, repetitive, rule-governed work
practices.why_it_matters: Clear right answers and a measurable saving

practices.practice: Check data readiness before choosing a use case
practices.why_it_matters: An agent can only use data that is accessible and clean

candidates.name: Autonomous tax return filer
candidates.what_the_agent_does: Prepares and files client tax returns without review.
candidates.gap: Returns are prepared by hand under deadline pressure.
candidates.rating_reason: Huge time saving but a filing error is costly.

candidates.name: Client document chaser
candidates.what_the_agent_does: Sends reminders for missing monthly documents and sorts what arrives into the client folder for a bookkeeper to confirm.
candidates.gap: Staff chase clients by email and phone every month.
candidates.rating_reason: High volume, repetitive, low harm if a reminder is wrong.

candidates.name: Engagement knowledge base
candidates.what_the_agent_does: Organizes past work papers, templates and client notes so staff and later agents can search them with citations.
candidates.gap: Knowledge lives in individual folders and people's heads.
candidates.rating_reason: Foundation for the other ideas; low risk.

candidates.name: New-client intake summarizer
candidates.what_the_agent_does: Turns the intake form into a summary and pre-fills the practice and billing systems for a person to approve.
candidates.gap: The same information is typed into two systems.
candidates.rating_reason: Removes double entry; a person approves.

candidates.name: Transaction categorizer
candidates.what_the_agent_does: Suggests categories for bank transactions; the bookkeeper accepts or corrects them.
candidates.rating_reason: Valuable but errors reach the books.

candidates.name: Overdue invoice follow-up
candidates.what_the_agent_does: Drafts polite reminders for overdue invoices for the office manager to send.
candidates.gap: Follow-up happens only when there is time.
candidates.rating_reason: Quick to build; a person sends.
